create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor nn.Module that scales input tensors by a fitted scale factor parameter
build_ScaleFactor_fit_context: build a fitting pipeline using ScaleFactor fit_context_ to collect variance stats then call fit_ to compute the scale
test_ScaleFactor_forward: test the ScaleFactor forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying it is multiplied by the fitted scale factor
refactor_ScaleFactor_set: refactor the ScaleFactor set_ method to validate consistency before filling the scale factor with a new value
review_ScaleFactor_observe: review the ScaleFactor _observe method that accumulates input and output variance statistics during the fitting context
